district: Red Bluff Joint Union High School District
summary: A Yes vote authorizes the district to issue up to $19,000,000 in general obligation bonds for school facility projects, repaid by an ad valorem property tax estimated at $19 per $100,000 of assessed value.

tax.text: A Yes vote would authorize a $19 million education bond costing property owners $19 per $100,000 of assessed value.
tax.quote: Measure H is a proposed $19 million education bond that would cost voters $19 per $100,000 of assessed, not market, property value.
